text:
```yaml
name: Auto Assign Milestone

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [closed]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  auto_assign_milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Install policy-bot-action
        run: npm install @microsoft/policy-bot-action

      - name: Run policy-bot-action
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          npx policy-bot-action --config .github/policies/milestoneAssignment.prClosed.yml
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/auto-assign-milestone.yml` automates the process of assigning milestones to pull requests based on their target branch. It triggers on specific events related to pull requests and uses the `policy-bot-action` tool to apply the defined policies. The workflow checks out the repository, sets up the .NET SDK, installs the necessary dependencies, and then runs the policy bot action with the specified configuration file.
